scope: Static readiness review only. No helper/native/build/test/network execution, source/Git edits or actual checkpoint/log/config/auth/database/archive reads. Narrow adjacent helper source was read only to identify existing schema fields.

findings.finding: Ancillary stage checkpoints are admitted only by passed and revision. Their native identity, owning diagnostic config/instance, original receipt and actual closure fields are not compared with the admitted current package/receipt, yet disposition assigns them actual native PASS. A different build/profile or incomplete/inconsistent stage document with the same revision can receive current credit.
findings.minimal_fix: Compare available identity/profile/receipt/cleanup/source fields before any referenced artifact selection. Headless identity resides in fixed execution/observations.json rather than its wrapper checkpoint. Derive qualification groups/counts from the actual validated profile/receipt, not an unchecked q.groups_completed scalar.
findings.regression: Reject same-revision portable/unattended/backup identity mismatch, owning-profile mismatch and wrong receipt before any retention write.

findings.finding: validate_qualified_receipt checks protected artifact bytes, but collection later selects files with glob/is_file and reads fresh unprotected Path.read_bytes. A validated artifact replaced between validation and retention can publish different bytes, or follow a linked private target, and its newly calculated original_hash does not establish the receipt's expected commitment. Unexpected matching log/kit files are also selected without an exact admitted public inventory.
findings.minimal_fix: Capture each receipt artifact using artifact_bytes, require the declared hash and store that exact raw snapshot for retention. Capture known stage reports/logs/tools with bounded protected local readers; admit fixed public roots/names before following references and compare producer hashes/review commitments where available. Retain only captured snapshots. Verify protected retained readbacks and exact intended serialized disposition before announcing success; guard destination containment/ordinary ancestors.
findings.regression: After successful initial validation replace an expected artifact with altered bytes or an owned link; require refusal before publication and prove no linked/private-target read. An unexpected glob-matching public fixture must not silently join the corpus.

findings.finding: The mandatory stage set requires a separate native07 checkpoint/workspace. The current plan deliberately executes scoped native04 followed by the complete owning seven-group qualification; full PQR-07 is already present in the validated receipt artifact closure. Thus the current retainer blocks an otherwise valid planned checkpoint, or invites redundant execution/incorrect old scoped credit.
findings.minimal_fix: Remove separate native07 from mandatory stages and its standalone collector branch. Add only the exact scoped native04 preflight corpus, separately labeled and identity/closure checked, while PQR-07 credit/artifacts come from the validated owning receipt. Do not add preflight counts to owning qualification counts.
findings.regression: A valid controlled complete receipt including PQR-07 plus scoped04 is admitted without a separate native07 directory; missing owning PQR-07 still fails the actual typed validator.

confirmed: The actual typed receipt validator provides a strong current subject/profile/member/artifact gate; preserve it.
Disposition keeps Master IN_PROGRESS and separates diagnostic BLOCKED/OOS/Paper/forward/Ubuntu/real cloud gaps; those boundaries should remain.
Raw original SHA and sanitized retained SHA are separate, which is appropriate once they refer to admitted captured snapshots.
limitations: This is the pre-remediation helper hash. Root is editing the external retainer; changes need a fresh bounded hash-bound delta check.
No current full owning or ancillary stage PASS is certified by this review.
No whole-requirement or whole-Master acceptance is issued.
